documents_expiration_after_issue_chk.name: documents_expiration_after_issue_chk

user_role_scopes_subject_chk.name: user_role_scopes_subject_chk

user_role_scopes_target_chk.name: user_role_scopes_target_chk
user_role_scopes_target_chk.value: ("user_role_scopes"."scope_type" = 'GLOBAL' AND "user_role_scopes"."scope_target_id" IS NULL) OR ("user_role_scopes"."scope_type" <> 'GLOBAL' AND "user_role_scopes"."scope_target_id" IS NOT NULL)
